Um projeto costuma passar por várias vot: A bill usually goes through several votes on the floor. Only the ones that decide on the bill itself, that is, to approve or reject it, are included here. Votes on urgency (which only decide whether the bill moves faster), on motions, on isolated amendments or separate votes on one passage (which vote on changing a part of the text) and on procedure are left out. That is why a bill that was voted on many times may appear with only one vote. Sometimes the Chamber votes on a substitute text, a new text that replaces the original. That vote appears, with a warning: the summary was written from the official summary (ementa) of the original bill, and the text voted on may be different.
Uma inteligência artificial lê o texto o: An artificial intelligence reads the official text of each bill, chooses the subject and writes a summary in plain language. It can be wrong. When there is doubt, the bill shows a warning. Nobody reviews the summaries before they go live, and for now the site has no way to request corrections. If something looks odd, check the official text.
